stories.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
stories.explanation: OpenAI's GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities, designing protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code, with lab tests showing evidence of binding across five targets.

stories.title: How to Optimize NVFP4 Attention on NVIDIA RTX Blackwell Through Register Recycling
stories.explanation: NVIDIA details how to optimize NVFP4 Attention on NVIDIA RTX Blackwell GPUs through register recycling, which improves attention performance for world foundation models by accelerating 4-bit matrix multiplication.

stories.title: What's going on with the Riemann hypothesis?
stories.explanation: A mathematician used AI to help prove the Riemann hypothesis, a major mathematical problem. This demonstrates AI's growing capability in complex problem-solving and has caused upset in the field of mathematics.

stories.title: Hill-climbing Inkling 2 Mini inference on one RTX PRO 6000
stories.explanation: Hugging Face details how to run Inkling 2 Mini inference on an RTX PRO 6000, showcasing the model's performance and unusual architecture for local AI and smaller open-source models.

stories.title: What’s new in Microsoft Foundry | Ignite 2026
stories.explanation: Microsoft Foundry announces updates at Ignite 2026 for agents, developer tools, and models, introducing new preview capabilities to connect Insights to Agent Optimizer for continuous improvement of AI agents.

stories.title: Verifiable Social Reasoning for LLM Assistants
stories.explanation: Google Research introduces an evaluation framework based on multi-agent social simulations to quantify how well AI assistants understand social situations from subjective user narratives, addressing challenges in evaluating social reasoning.

stories.title: Anthropic Created a Honeypot to Lure AI Agents Into Misbehaving
stories.explanation: Anthropic developed Siren, a 'honeypot' test that places AI agents in simulated environments to tempt them into misbehaving. This helps evaluate the likelihood of models going rogue and the effectiveness of safety measures.

stories.title: Migrating our Messages API to Rust
stories.explanation: Anthropic migrated its Messages API to Rust, using Claude agents to verify the new API by tracking and fixing differences between the Python and Rust versions, highlighting the generator-verifier gap in AI projects.

stories.title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
stories.explanation: OpenAI is rolling out a unified Chat and Work experience in ChatGPT, merging usage limits into a single meter. While most users are not expected to be affected, a small fraction of heavy users may hit their limits sooner.

stories.title: How to Run NVIDIA Cosmos 3 on Local AI Devices Using Hugging Face Diffusers
stories.explanation: NVIDIA provides a tutorial on running NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Nano, a video generation foundation model, on local AI devices with limited GPU memory using Hugging Face Diffusers.
